title: Moroccan Yoghurt with Dates and Almonds
summary: A simple Moroccan-style breakfast bowl with creamy yoghurt, sticky dates, toasted almonds and warm cinnamon. It’s lightly sweet, fresh and ready in minutes.
steps: Toast the chopped almonds in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, until lightly golden and fragrant. Set aside to cool slightly.
Divide the yoghurt between two bowls and smooth the surface with the back of a spoon.
Top with the chopped dates and toasted almonds, then dust evenly with cinnamon.
Serve immediately, or chill for 10 minutes if you prefer it colder.
